Passed to be engrossed

MA-2025-S3287.description: Senate, October 22, 2026 -- Substituted as a new draft (Senator Driscoll) for the Senate Bill relative to amending the charter of the city known as the town of Randolph regarding filling of vacancies, running for multiple offices, term of office for Stetson Trustees and three-month prohibition on work for the town after service in elected office (Senate, No. 3084).
MA-2025-S3287.descriptionSource: Official abstract — summary (state legislature, via Open States)
MA-2025-S3287.aiSummary: The bill would change the charter for the town of Randolph, which is run as a city, on how vacancies are filled and whether a person can run for more than one office. It would also change the term for Stetson Trustees and add a three-month wait before a former elected official can work for the town.
